But a daguerreotype would not be ignored. That night, by gaslight, Thomas Beckett examined it: the handwriting, the seal, the date — twenty years gone. And the name. The name that the disgraced lord had paid good money to bury.

CHAPTER 3: The Witness

Thomas Beckett wrote it all down, every thread, every name, and sealed it three ways. If the disgraced lord silenced them, the story would still speak. courage in every age — even in the docks of Liverpool, even then.
